error.message: {corpus}/inputs/plane-tilted.nii.gz is a 2-D plane not parallel to the x-y world plane, and §3.6 gives a 2-D grid a 2x2 direction on the first two world axes --- no 2-D grid describes it; save it as (x, y, 1), or pass plane_as_volume=True (--plane-as-volume), to import it as a single-slice 3-D volume
